title: How Vanta Cut Ramp Time by 60% and Got Reps to Pipeline 30% Faster
summary: How Vanta cut SDR ramp time by 60%, got reps to pipeline 30% faster, and influenced $125M+ in pipeline with Hyperbound.
body_markdown:
## At a glance


> “Without that, we would not have hit our pipeline goals… let alone our revenue goals.”


Stevie Case, CRO


The problem


## Growth outpaced enablement


The company shifted from primarily inbound to outbound-driven pipeline. The product evolved into a multi-product platform. And reps were expected to sell into highly technical personas like CISOs and security leaders.


1. 01


Coaching was still manual. Managers ran roleplays, reviewed calls, and delivered feedback one rep at a time.


2. 02


Ramp times stretched past 200 days.


3. 03


Performance became inconsistent. Managers were spread thin trying to support both new hires and experienced reps.


When ramp takes that long, it delays everything: pipeline generation, hiring ROI, performance visibility. It also makes it harder to answer a critical question: Is this rep going to succeed here? By the time you find out, you’ve already lost time.


> “We were missing pipeline targets. It was taking a very long time for SDRs to get productive.”


Stevie Case, CRO


The solution


## Practice that drives real performance


Vanta moved from episodic training to continuous performance improvement. Reps weren’t just trained during onboarding. They improved every day: before calls, between calls, and in response to what they were seeing in the field.


01


Use case


Practice


### It made practice relevant.


Instead of generic roleplays, reps were preparing for real conversations. That made the learning stick and translated directly into live performance.


Vanta’s reps sell to founders and to CISOs, two buyers who expect deep security and compliance expertise. Earlier roleplay tools felt robotic and reps didn’t engage. Hyperbound gave them verbal practice that felt like real conversations with real-world objections.


> “We were able to drive what felt like real life human conversations with real world objections and the way that real human beings would be talking to them on the phone.”


Stevie Case, CRO


02


Use case


Practice


### It removed managers as the bottleneck.


Reps no longer had to wait for feedback. They could practice, adjust, and improve in real time while managers focused on higher-impact coaching.


Before Hyperbound, coaching meant one-on-one practice between managers and reps over Zoom or in conference rooms. Every product or competitive change meant coaching the team again. With the SDR team about to quadruple and many new managers still learning the business, that model couldn’t hold.


> “As these managers grew their teams, that became really difficult because if you’re spending that much time ramping one person, the rest of the team is not getting attention.”


Stevie Case, CRO


03


Use case


Practice


### It created consistency across a team that was scaling too quickly for human-led coaching alone.


Every rep was learning the same messaging, practicing the same scenarios, and being held to the same standard.


Vanta first tried scoring calls and having managers give feedback, but that feedback reached reps days or weeks later. With Hyperbound, every SDR got the same experience, practiced the same talk tracks, and received the same feedback.


> “We knew we needed a solution that was going to grow with us and be dynamic.”


Stevie Case, CRO


04


Use case


Practice


### It gave reps a way to build confidence before high-stakes conversations.


When you’re selling to technical buyers, confidence isn’t optional; it’s required. And confidence only comes from repetition. This system gave reps that repetition before it mattered.


CISOs are skeptical, hard to reach, and quick to hang up on anyone who can’t speak credibly about SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001. Reps rehearse those conversations until they can hold them.


> “The single most important thing that we do to make sure that those reps have confidence going into these high stakes conversations is practice.”


Stevie Case, CRO


Hyperbound’s impact


## Faster ramp, faster pipeline


What used to take over 200 days now takes just 75. That alone changes the economics of hiring. Reps start contributing earlier, which means pipeline starts building sooner.


> “We were able to reduce the time to ramp for an SDR by more than 60%… completely game-changing.”


Stevie Case, CRO


Time to first meeting and time to first opportunity both improved by more than 30%. Instead of waiting months to see meaningful output, Vanta could rely on new hires to start generating meetings and opportunities within weeks.


The SDR organization grew from roughly 30 reps to over 120 in a short period of time. At that scale, small improvements compound quickly. More reps ramping faster. More reps generating pipeline sooner. More total pipeline created. That’s what drives a number like $125M+.


At Vanta, the goal wasn’t to improve training. It was to improve outcomes. They needed a way to ramp reps faster, maintain consistency, and generate pipeline at a pace that matched their growth.


> “We grew from 38 to 120 reps in 16 months… there’s no way that we would have been able to do that successfully without Hyperbound.”


Willie Pierson, Global Head of Sales Development
